case.summary: Alert HHF-017 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.55 on online transaction 3638829 ($43.92) for card C08842-K2. Although the purchase utilized device D000503 behind an anonymous proxy, the device has no ties to fraud rings or other cards. The transaction aligned with the cardholder's primary billing region 299, showed no card testing or burst velocity, and matched historical product spending patterns. With no prior confirmed fraud on the holder identity and past model alert CC-0026 having been cleared, the activity is determined to be legitimate cardholder conduct.
